unitTitle: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood
title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 6: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Le studio coûte mille trois cent cinquante dollars. L'appartement d'une chambre est plus spacieux, mais il coûte cent dollars de plus.
steps.question: Which home costs less?
steps.explain: The studio is $1,350; the one-bedroom costs $100 more.

steps.fr: La buanderie est au sous-sol. La laveuse et la sécheuse sont dans cette salle.
steps.question: Where are the washer and dryer?
steps.explain: The speaker says they are in the basement laundry room.

steps.fr: Je cherche un logement paisible près du train. Le studio est moins grand, mais son trajet est plus court.
steps.question: Why does the speaker prefer the studio?
steps.explain: The speaker says the studio has the shorter trip.

steps.fr: Le loyer comprend le chauffage central et l'eau. Les frais d'électricité sont en plus.
steps.question: Which cost is extra?
steps.explain: The message says electricity costs are extra.

steps.fr: Le logement B est aussi près de l'épicerie que le logement A, mais il est plus éloigné de l'arrêt d'autobus.
steps.question: Which home is farther from the bus stop?
steps.explain: The speaker says home B is farther from the bus stop.
